This '''Sith ritual altar''' was a crystalline structure located in the secretive part of the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center|Surgical Center]].<ref name="Complete Locations" />

==History==
The altar was found on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]. [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] later relocated it to the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center|EmPal SuRecon Center]] and used it as part of his [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Force]] reservoir.<ref name="Complete Locations" />
